title: Independent analyses urge caution on Jev benchmarks
summary: Multiple third-party write-ups (The Tech Society, DataCamp, dev.to) compile Jev's numbers and flag that the 4-workflow benchmark is vendor-run, with consensus labels generated by GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 rather than ground truth. Accuracy on your own traffic remains the recommended test.

summary: After launch-day demand, TypeSafe reported moving 140k signups off the waitlist within roughly a day and a half, while asking new users to keep using the Vercel AI Gateway in the meantime. title: Launch: TypeSafe introduces System One Models and Jev
summary: TypeSafe AI launches Jev, a model that returns typed decisions (Choice, Score, Noul) with calibrated probabilities instead of generating text. Headline claims: 193.6x faster and 444.6x cheaper than frontier LLMs on System One workflows, $0.042 per 1M input tokens with output unmetered, and 0% schema/type errors by construction.
